_readme: D-010 — the measured parameters of the context budget. Every number here was measured, or is null until it is. Changed only by `bun scripts/synthesis/budget.ts --set k=v`, never by hand. Percentages are of the model's context window (context-ceilings.json). Measured 2026-09-04 on the Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) primary conversation of session 014, run 02 (8 units), from the statusline log — see docs/analysis/dynamic-batching-experiment.md §9.
start_pct_note: S — the session-start protocol (§8.1) before any unit work; measured 9.03. Falls to ~6.9 with the two-view METHOD read and the unit table outside STATE.md; re-measured every conversation by --record start / dispatch.
run_fixed_pct_note: R — cost of one run that does not depend on its size: pre-dispatch 1.8 + monitoring 2.1 + recording 0.7. Falls to ~2.5 with await-run.ts replacing the per-report edit cycle; re-measured every run.
per_unit_pct_note: u — verification of one unit (quote-check --summary, stamp, head of one card); measured 15,737 tokens / 8 units. Replaces the 0.53 of session 014, which was R spread over the units.
close_pct_note: C — §8.3 close (results, next brief, handoff, checks, commits); measured 3.60 including the next run's brief.
ceiling_pct_override_note: null → the governing ceiling comes from context-ceilings.json for the running model. A number here overrides it (the experiment used 21).
max_clean_run_note: largest run size so far that returned zero quote-check FAIL, zero 429 and no rot metric — the next size in run_sizes is tried once this is proven
max_clean_concurrency_note: largest number of Teamwork runs dispatched at the same time from one conversation that finished clean and within the wall-time bound
wall_time_bound_note: a step up in run size or concurrency counts as clean only if the run's wall time is within this percentage of the previous clean step at the same unit cap — a longer wall time at the same unit sizes means the harness is queueing conversations, and that is the stream limit
compaction_note: harness compaction is NOT a ceiling: it fired at ~10% in session 013 and not at 18% in session 014; it is handled by §8.4, not by this budget
